caret-color: rgb(37, 37, 37); color: #252525; font-size: 16px; white-space: pre-wrap;\"\u003E\nI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of patient clinical data analysis to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan.\n\n18 y\/o female patient came to opd \n\nChief Complaints:\n\nA 18 year old female patient , came to opd on 3rd of January with chief complaints of shortness of breath since two days and fever since 1 week along with pain and swelling in the perianal region since 10 days\n\nHistory of present illness:\n\nThe patient was apparently asymptomatic 6 years back\n\nCourse of events:\n\n6 years ago:\n\nShe went to a nearby hospital\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"\u0026quot;Open Sans\u0026quot;, sans-serif\" style=\"box-sizing: inherit; color: #818181; font-size: 16px; white-space: pre-wrap;\"\u003E because of her weakness, polyuria, polydipsia, polyphagia, and weight loss and she was diagnosed with diabetes; she then started using insulin injections as prescribed by a local doctor\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"\u0026quot;Open Sans\u0026quot;, sans-serif\" style=\"box-sizing: inherit; color: #818181; font-size: 16px; white-space: pre-wrap;\"\u003E\n\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"box-sizing: inherit; color: #818181; font-size: 16px; white-space: pre-wrap;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier;\"\u003EInjecction mixtard \u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"\u0026quot;Open Sans\u0026quot;, sans-serif\" style=\"box-sizing: inherit;
